functions.recoveredRole: Refresh the available-curve list after the Measurement filter changes
functions.behavior: Passes the Add Curve form and regular filter mode to the shared available-list rebuild. The rebuild reads MeasCB.Checked with the other category controls, excludes objects already selected for insertion, applies the text filter, and repopulates AvailableCurvesLB without changing the selected-curves list.
functions.evidence: The DFM binds MeasCB.OnClick to address 013d0540 and gives the control the caption Measurement. The recovered handler contains only FUN_013cab80(param_1, 0). The DFM field order and the rebuild's form accesses map MeasCB to +0x7c8; FUN_013cab80 tests that checked state for objects in the collection referenced by PTR_DAT_02001d00, then adds accepted display-string and object pairs to AvailableCurvesLB at +0x778.
